name: fancycursive

displayName_i18n.zh-CN: FancyCursive 花体字与连笔字标

description: Convert plain text into copy-paste Unicode cursive and decorated fancy styles, search curated Unicode symbols, decorate display names with platform character-limit checks, and render true-outline connected-script PNG/SVG lettering.

description_i18n.en: Convert plain text into copy-paste Unicode cursive and decorated fancy styles, search curated Unicode symbols, decorate display names with platform character-limit checks, and render true-outline connected-script PNG/SVG lettering.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 将文本转换为可复制粘贴的 Unicode 花体与花式样式、检索常用符号、按平台规则装饰昵称，并生成透明 PNG 与真轮廓连笔 SVG 字标。
